note: Each bound operand is the exact vulnerable-version expression evaluated at the ASSERT_EVT site for the selected minimal chain: `sub_list` at the resolver append; `i->data` and the `i->flavor` predicates at the map-class verifier; and `cmp` at the cast and recursive-call lines. Literal helper operands ending in `true_literal` are intentionally omitted because the binding gate treats them as compile-time literals rather than source expressions.
